title: pace-code-e.pdf — section 4
text:
1.9 Designated persons and other police staff must have regard to any relevant provisions
of the Codes of Practice.

1.10 References to pocket book include any official report book issued to police officers or
police staff.

1.11 References to a custody officer include those performing the functions of a custody
officer as in paragraph 1.9 of Code C.

2 Recording and sealing master recordings

2.1 Not used.
